rules.title: Logistics words: warehouse, receive, schedule
rules.short_explanation: Common logistics words often have difficult letter patterns: warehouse, shipment, receive, invoice, delivery, schedule, equipment, receipt and inventory. Learn them as complete words and check the vowels carefully.
rules.tts_text: Learn logistics words like warehouse, receive and schedule.
rules.mnemonic: Receive: e before i, except after c.

examples.text: The warehouse is full of new stock.
examples.note: Warehouse has hou in the middle.

examples.text: The shipment left the factory today.
Please receive the goods at the gate.
The invoice must be paid this week.
examples.note: Invoice has oi in the middle.

examples.text: The delivery arrives before noon.
Check the schedule for the next shift.
The equipment is stored on the ground floor.
examples.note: Equipment has qui in the middle.

examples.text: Keep the receipt for the office.
The inventory list is in the system.
The freight arrives by train.
Please label every package clearly.
examples.note: Label has one l after b.
